Name: (AT) Moe Alpaca
Author: Schamarchs
Description:
Alpaca sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description]Alternative Textures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url].

Comes in 14 colours. Use the scissors from Alternative Textures on your alpacas to change their sprite to a different colour or back to the original.

[b]Installation
[/b]       > Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ and requirements.
       > Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url]﻿ and requirements.
       > Download (AT) Moe Alpaca.

[b]Credits[/b] ~ Thanks to you, this mod was possible! :)
       [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd?gameId=1303]PeacefulEnd[/url] - Alternative Textures
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]       omena007[/url] - Alpacas

Please enjoy!
